verdict.rationale: Factory documents `droid exec` as a headless, one-shot mode built for CI/CD pipelines and scripts. It supports structured input/output and tiered autonomy, so a pipeline step can run unattended tasks such as fixing code. The SDK and Sessions API add other ways to trigger the agent programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented recipe for detecting and fixing a failing build or test from CI, examples of committing or opening a PR with the fix, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
